notes.title: The Pushy One
notes.content:
Greetings, For this patch we are introducing a more effective conservation of momentum. So what does this mean? Basically if you are bigger than the bot you hit you should push it with regards to speed and mass (Chassis and turrets have mass but its not exposed to the player)
This was somewhat working ok but I went a bit further and stopped the bots from resisting the push if they should be pushed. This really means you don't stop dead when you run into a smaller bot than you now but you do still slow down.


I also have gotten a lot of Gamepad work done. This includes being able to remap the bindings completely without need to use a keyboard or mouse. Better navigation for the UI and some other bug fixes related to gamepad.

The fit save system has had a polish pass, now when you load a fit the name will be entered into the name field. Same names will be asked if you want to replace the fit now too.

A few more fixes here and there as well. From here on I am mainly working on boss mechanics and new maps and assets to make those maps not feel empty so i hope to have something new out at the start of June (New maps won't be out till release) 
List of changes below.

-Added in logic for movement bump for momentum conservation.
-force player always be the bumper meaning it should push bots if it can. (acc is not taken into account at this stage)
-Added in a way for the player to push bots, end up using a method of using last input + hit velocity clamped by max speed. this lets the player push small objects around but not the bigger ones a little janky but works well (need to test it on a slower machine though)
-Added outline to heads-up Hud elements
-Tweaked colors and vibrance of Heads Up elements
-Remade Lock-on circle to be thinner and have blend in and out
-Fixed issue with boss not waking up correctly
-Added logic for push to not include units that don't move
-fixed reload on rocket turret to show the reloaded ammo number at the end of the reload cycle.
-Fixed an issue where you could reload again while reloading
-Fixed rocket smoke effect been culled from pool to early
-Added small beep when reload starts
-Updated Passive and Active slots to look better
-Fix color issues with slots
-Tweaked slot color pulse
-Tweaked slot layout in loadout
-refactored key Selectors
-Reworked key binding so that adding new bindings is easy.
-Added controller images and logic to display those images where necessary
-Fix issue with the controller remapping. It can be done with the controller.
-fix game pad navigation in various widgets, main menu, Debriefing & game over.
-loading a fit now set the name in the field
-save a fit with the same name will now bring up a warning to overwrite the old save.
-fixed issues with v-keyboard not been right scale
-fixed highlight issues causing color to be set to 0 alpha
-Fixed issue where colors wouldn't be loaded in the color painter.

Happy Slagging!

notes.title: Continue your Slagging
notes.content:
Greetings, We hope everyone had a great new year and break!
Today we bring you the ability stop and continue your game. By this you can now stop playing after completing a level or dying, close the game completely and come back to it when you have the time to play or you are less disappointed in your slagging ability's.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44193721/6b0549044a218309f4bf4dc86d0579e1e752fbd7.png[/img]
We also have introduce more data into the loadout of your tank so you now have a better idea of how different mods affect your tank. This should help you build the tank to your needs for better slagging efficiency 

High scores have been reworked as well. 
For level high score it looks at time you took to complete it.
For run high scores, it looks at how many levels you have completed then how may times you have died and finally your total time.
this will be looked at more latter as I want to add a high score viewer, I also want to add top 3 runs rather than just the best run. but this is polish and will come at the end of development. 
There also have been a tone of small fixes and tweaks such as adding an extra passive slot to the the small ball body and track body.

Most of the changes a listed below (the ones I remembered to note down) 

[list]
[*] Refactored save data
[*] Added continue functionality
[*] Refactored level high scores
[*] Refactored run high scores
[*] Refactored passive buffs system 
[*] Adjusted small Mag Ball body to have 3 passive slots (was 2)
[*] Adjusted small Track body to have 4 passive slots (was 3)
[*] Fixed compeer holding last hovered turret or body when look at mods
[*] Fixed issues where damage was not been show correctly in loadout
[*] Added more information on tank build to loadout 
[*] Fixed issue where new tec was not been show in HUD when acquired
[*] Fixed a bug where NPC's where shooting over the player, this Increased incoming  damage so reduced the spawn amounts slightly to compensate 
[/list]- 

while these changes don't look like much a lot has changed. 
Happy Slagging!

notes.title: Demo
notes.content:
Today we have pre-released our demo a day early for Next Feast.
Over the last Month there has been a lot of play testing, debugging and Improvements made to Slag, in preparation for this so we really hope you enjoy it and get a feel for what Slag is all about!

In this demo version only the first 5 levels are available, how ever you can continue a playthrough that will repeat these 5 levels with increasing difficulty to let you play with all the different tec that would be unlocked.

All the tec that can be seen in game can be unlocked and used by Slagging the bosses on the 5 levels available. you will need to clear all 5 levels to get 1 core for one of the two core upgrades that are available. 
Tec is one time unlocked so on your next new game it will remained unlocked. you may not have the res to use it though.

There is of course much more work to  be done and at this stage we will not be taking the demo down with out a fair amount of warning. It will also receive updates and polish as the main game gets more flushed out as well. This is especially true when it comes to the "loadout" screen as its still not were we are happy with it. 

I will also be streaming over the Next Feast Event so if you want to come ask questions or just hangout you can keep an eye out for when that goes live or follow us at https://www.twitch.tv/blackrobingames

Happy Slagging!

notes.content:

Todays update brings a number of fixes and improvements to the game. 
Here are the changes and additions.

-Fix material so laser pointer renders all the way to the cursor. (Note some weapons aim just above the cursor to give better general hit while others aim more at the ground to use AOE)
-Fix turret not adjusting height when there is no target

-Fix empty slots not having the empty slot mod.
-Fixed loading in loadout of base build to allow for 1 nano rep and plate for free.
-Change default sizes of the cursor and its min and max possible sizes.
-Fixed color save slots losing there saved color.
-Added descriptions to all chassis and turrets.

-All tec is exposed on start now and should be greyed out when it hasn't been unlocked.

notes.title: Pre Next Feast Build
notes.content:
Greetings!
Today I have a big Update for slag and the Announcement that Slag will be in the  up in coming Next Feast in October!
This also means I am working on a Demo build for all to play this will be the first 5 levels only and the tec tree will be limited as well. but it should give players a good and fair feel for the game that I am trying to make here and I also get the chance to adjust it where needed to suit players as well. 
That been said Lest get into the Update changes.

-Major world tile texture update, This took some time to get right and it has blowen the budget in terms of time I wanted to spend on it but I think the results speak for them self's, the look and feel of the new 
way of doing these world tile textures makes the structure you are navigating feel bigger and is much more pleasing to the eye.
-Aim Assistance Tweaks. Added an influence of where the player is trying to aim to this so you can now lead the aim assistance where needed. Mainly for static turrets I found this felling magnitudes better.
-Reworked Level layout and Difficulty. Made the over alpha strike damage much lower so you don't get volleyed of the map when going through a game.  
-Added Boss and Objective Progress bars to the Hud. This is the heath bars you see in other games but this is based on the room so if you have a hack object in the room you will have a hacking bar at the top of the screen etc.
-Added new logic for bosses. More for me to control there movement and when they do x ability but still makes the game more interesting.
-Cleaned up UI in various places and added back texture to the Hud elements 
-Added more effects.
-Bug fixes (there were a lot)
-Res Gain and loss numbers. these pop up when you gain or spend Res during game play.

There are loads more changes from big to small in the background too.
If you are interested in getting into the closed testing that is going on right now please contact HypoConDreAct on our discord for a possible key. 

Happy Slagging!

notes.title: Gamepad Support
notes.content:
Greetings,
Today we are very pleased to put this update out for testing.
It includes a major push for gamepad support to where it is nearly fully supported. There are a few parts that still needed work and that is the remapping key selectors (you can remap the button layout completely)
and the crash-corse page. 
With gamepad support we had to implement an aim assist system that helps the player shoot. The math is normally rather straight forward for this until you add turret turn rates into the equation, this means that the prediction is sometimes off, This more relies on the player positioning and attack angels to help it aim for more constantan hits. That been said its still rather good as long as your not glancing past your target. 
Speaking of targets the aim assist does target and is now indicated by the red circle around the bot. Targets are acquired by pointing the main turret at a bot, it will always grab the closest bot if there are many bots in a row. The player can issues a retarget command or if you pull your aim away from the current target it will drop the old target and get another. Middle mouse button for keyboard users and right thumb stick button for gamepad users.
the Target angel is different for each controller type. 15 degrees for keyboard, and 35 degrees for gamepad. This, in testing felt the best, but we may add a way to lower this depending on feedback.
This system can be disabled for keyboard/mouse users in the settings menu. Do note that this setting does not save at this stage and will have to be reset if you exit the game and reload. 

With the addition of map changes that should make the game a bit less brutal and should make the over all play a bit more fun. There are also a tone of other changes and bug fixes that have come in this patch along with some graphical fixes  as well 
I do hope you enjoy the changes and the bit more relaxed game play state 

Happy Slagging!

notes.title: Save & Load
notes.content:
Greetings,
Today we have a bigger update this includes many fixes and some new features!
There now is a save and load system for Loadouts, this will carry across from run to run so you can save a fit you like and now load it if you die in another run, as long as you have enough res that is. 
Also have reworked the main information panel in the loadout to try make it better at showing the information to you. This is still work in progress and does have a few odd behaviour at this stage that will get fixed in the coming weeks leading up to Christmas. 

There are many fixes in this patch as well some minor some major but over all should see better game play! 

Enjoy and let me hear your feed back!

notes.title: Testing in progress
notes.content:
[h1][/h1]

Hello and welcome! 
I am very proud to say that we have now got a closed beta build of Slag up and running for testing on steam. 
If your interested in testing the game you can get in touch with me HypoConDreAct aka Luke, by either emailing me at HypoConDreAct@gmail.com or by joining our discord here https://discord.gg/c8MacNYuKJ .There are only a few slots open for testing so get in quick!
Do try to keep in mind we are based in New Zealand so our responses can be slow but we will get back to you as soon as we can. 
On to the Juice and what you can expect at this stage of development, Right now we are still in a slight Alpha state as there are a few more mechanics we would like to get up and running, so that means we do  
not have a huge amount of polish done yet.
There are bugs, some we know about and some we have know idea about, but we will squash them like these bot and if we could "Slag em" as well! 
There is and endless game loop running in this state, so you can keep running the 5 levels we have set up they get harder the deeper you go. There is a level stat and run stat system in place so you can try run them as fast as you can or as efficient as you can as all actions in Slag cost some res (apart from shooting).
there a lot of work to do but I am really hoping to push devolvement as fast as we can from here to get to a release state!
Hope to talk to you soon and that you get to have fun turning these bots to Slag!
